title: Denver Broncos QB Bo Nix doesn’t put pressure on himself over slow starts

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Denver Broncos QB Bo Nix doesn’t put pressure on himself over slow starts
sources.description: The question that is making the rounds this week about the Denver Broncos have been centered around their slow starts in games. Mostly that question has been directed at head coach Sean Payton, but quarterback Bo Nix got hit with one today as well when he was asked if he puts any added pressure on […]
